posts.title: everything you do get reinforced
posts.description: After I started this writing practice, I quickly noticed that I started feeling the need to take benefit out of the insights I was having. This bought me the karma of feeling the need to share anything I learned. I started seeing potential posts everywhere I looked inside my own head. I stopped being a river and instead I become a clogged pipe that needs to occasionally remove these clogs to keep working. I don’t know if something like this will ever work, but I’m certain it won’t today. Past me, if you’re reading this, I want you to know that every time you try to reach for something better, you make yourself worse at enduring its absence. What you truly want is not to build the perfect context to be, but it is to be able to be in any context.

posts.title: content livespam
posts.description: I’ve noticed that knowledge quickly gets stale. This is why I’ve never been successful in creating written knowledge bases, as they’re always either outdated or slightly inaccurate. I strive to avoid spreading misinformation and hope to produce something useful for others, but as much as I wish I wasn't, I’m human. Up until now, I’ve been collecting my own writing to share with others someday. However, paying this debt seems nonsensical. If the words no longer represent the person who wrote them, why should I bother? The challenge of expressing myself on the internet is that, at least for me, it feels like the words I write are more like carvings than a conversation. For most of the time my species has been around, the vibrations in the air disappear and body gestures were gone after an exchange, and they'd never come back the same way. posts.title: Hating feels good.
posts.description: And that's the problem. It's because it feels good that it doesn't arrive from a logical place. So you do things you don't intend to because decompressing yourself by hating feels good. It's kind of like any other practice that, on a gut-level, we know is bad but do regardless—like eating fast food.
